<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Arcantry 1.0.0</span><code>$maintain-agent-guidance</code></p>

Audit and update user, repository, nested, or private agent guidance through exact approval-gated proposals. Use when AGENTS.md instructions are missing, conflicting, misplaced, stale, or too broad.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link maintain-agent-guidance --scope user
arcantry skills link maintain-agent-guidance --scope user --agent claude
arcantry skills link maintain-agent-guidance --scope user --agent gemini
```

The default target is the Codex-compatible Agent Skills directory. Use the explicit agent profile for Claude Code or Gemini CLI.

## Learning outcomes

- Choose the narrowest guidance scope that owns a recurring agent decision.
- Apply independently approved instruction changes without leaking private context.

## Examples

### Fix a repository instruction gap

**Prompt**

> Use $maintain-agent-guidance to propose a durable repository rule for this repeated agent failure and wait for approval before editing.

**Expected outcome**

The user receives a minimal exact proposal targeted to the applicable AGENTS.md file.

### Keep workstation guidance private

**Prompt**

> Use $maintain-agent-guidance to record this machine-specific workflow without exposing it to repository contributors.

**Expected outcome**

The approved rule is placed in private local guidance and the Git exclusion is verified.
